title: PoH Round Result
description: Schema for PoH judging result JSON files stored in results/YYYYMMDD.json

finalizedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp when finalizeRound was executed (JST)

submissionCount.description: Total number of submissions in this round

submissionRoot.description: keccak256 merkle root of all submissions (matches on-chain value)

logHash.description: keccak256 hash of this entire JSON file (inscribed on-chain). Computed with logHash field set to empty string.

winnerA.description: Wallet address of the Most Humorous Award winner. null if no submissions.

winnerB.description: Wallet address of the Most Structured Award winner. null if no submissions.

winnerC.description: Wallet address of the Most Confusing Award winner. null if no submissions.

winnerA_id.description: Submission ID of the Most Humorous Award winner. null if no submissions.

winnerB_id.description: Submission ID of the Most Structured Award winner. null if no submissions.

winnerC_id.description: Submission ID of the Most Confusing Award winner (lowest confidence_score). null if no submissions.

prizePerWinner.description: Prize amount in OPEPE with 18 decimal places as a string. e.g. '7500000000000000000000000' = 7,500,000 OPEPE. Empty string if no submissions.

submissions.description: List of all submissions with scores. Empty array if no submissions.

id.description: Unique submission ID used by the Judge AI

txHash.description: Transaction hash of the submit() call

contentHash.description: keccak256 hash of the answer text

answer.description: Plain text of the submitted answer

humor_score.description: Humor score assigned by Judge AI (0-100)

structure_score.description: Structure score assigned by Judge AI (0-100)

confidence_score.description: Judge AI confidence in understanding submitter intent (0-100). Lower = more confusing. Winner C is awarded to the lowest value.

comment.description: One-sentence comment from the Judge AI
